footer.units.axes: Chart axes show only the prefix (K, M, G, T), in the same units as above. Hover over a chart for exact values.
footer.units.bandwidth: Providers state bandwidth in bits per second: a 100 Mbps port moves at most about 11.9 M/s.
footer.units.bytes: Sizes (memory, disk, traffic) use binary units of 1024: KiB, MiB, GiB, TiB.
footer.units.providers: Providers usually count traffic in decimal GB and TB (1 GB = 1000³ bytes), so their figures differ from the panel's: 1 TB is about 931 GiB.
footer.units.rates: Network speeds are in bytes per second, in the same binary units: K/s, M/s, G/s.

hosts.error.cycle: Choose a reminder cycle from the list.
hosts.error.iface_exclude: Each pattern must be 1 to 32 printable characters without spaces, and a list holds at most 64 of them.
hosts.error.iface_mode: Choose System or Custom for the excluded network interfaces.
hosts.error.name: The name must be 1 to 64 characters and must not contain control characters.
hosts.error.note: The note must be at most 200 characters and must not contain control characters.
hosts.error.remind_start: Enter a valid first reminder date.
hosts.error.reset_day: Choose a reset day from 1 to 28.
hosts.error.sort: The sort value must be a whole number between -100000 and 100000.

hosts.iface.custom.hint: These rules replace the ones on the Settings page for this host. Comma-separated patterns, where * matches any characters. Leave empty to count every interface.
hosts.iface.list: Excluded network interfaces for this host
hosts.iface.system.hint: This host follows the interface rules on the Settings page.
hosts.install.intro: Run this command on the host as root. It downloads the agent installer, verifies its checksum and installs the agent.
hosts.install.next: The host appears as enrolled once its agent connects.
hosts.install.once: The token is shown only once. The panel keeps just its hash, and the token expires after 24 hours.
hosts.install.unpinned: This build of the panel pins no agent release, so the command below is an example: the version and checksum are placeholders.
hosts.name: Name
hosts.name.hint: Your label for this host, up to 64 characters.
hosts.reminder.hint: Kerge reminds you on the first reminder date and then once every cycle, on the same day of the month, or on the last day of a shorter month. It does not know when your provider actually bills you.
hosts.reset.body: The current agent stops reporting immediately. You get a new install command and have to run it on the host.
hosts.reset.title: Reset access for this host?
hosts.sort.hint: Hosts are listed from the lowest value to the highest.
hosts.traffic.hint: Traffic is counted per day and summed from the reset day of the current month, in the panel's time zone. Changing the reset day recounts the current cycle.
hosts.traffic.limit.hint: Leave empty for no limit. Providers usually sell traffic in GB or TB of 1000; this limit is in GiB of 1024.
hosts.traffic.reset_day.hint: The day of the month a new cycle starts.
